generic.consequence: Rewriting ordinary fused task training as recipient marginal utility adds no new gradient. GNCL/HGEN already provide peer-conditional task gradients in their inspected aggregate components.
generic.definition: For frozen peers c, define U_m=R(P_without_m(c))−R(P_with_m(η_m,c)). If the first term does not depend on η_m, −∇U_m=∇R(P_with_m).
generic.probability_pool: For each observed Bernoulli event q_m, L_pool=−log((q_m+Σpeer q_k)/M) gives ∇η_m L_pool=ρ_m∇η_m BCE_m, with ρ_m=q_m/(q_m+Σpeer q_k). Peers affect the credit coefficient.

source_specific.J: J_m=S_m−A_m where S uses recipient factual plus all peers under the same a-removed view, A uses recipient a-removed plus those same frozen peers.
source_specific.gradient: ρ_F∇BCE_factual−ρ_probe∇BCE_probe; coefficients nonnegative, probe term carries minus sign.
source_specific.operational_boundary: The baseline A depends on recipient private parameters through the probe, unlike leave-member-out constant baselines; same-family absence, private permissions and strict competence guards specify an intervention/update placement, not novelty.
source_specific.site_limit: If a permitted site has zero probe Jacobian, its negative probe contribution vanishes and it reduces to factual responsibility-weighted supervised credit at that state. A state-local output equality alone cannot establish Jacobian equality.
